tools.name: zeevou_list_properties
tools.description: List the properties (buildings or homes) in the Zeevou account, with address, status and default brand. Good first call. Zeevou API: GET /apis/properties.

tools.name: zeevou_get_property
tools.description: Get one property by id, with its address, check-in and check-out times, and amenities. Zeevou API: GET /apis/properties/{id}.

tools.name: zeevou_list_unit_types
tools.description: List unit types (the bookable room or home layouts, with bedrooms, capacity and rate plans). Zeevou API: GET /apis/unit_types.

tools.name: zeevou_get_unit_type
tools.description: Get one unit type by id, with its size, maximum capacity and amenities. Zeevou API: GET /apis/unit_types/{id}.

tools.name: zeevou_list_units
tools.description: List the individual rentable units (the physical rooms or homes) and whether each is active. Zeevou API: GET /apis/units.

tools.name: zeevou_get_unit
tools.description: Get one unit by id, with its unit type and status. Zeevou API: GET /apis/units/{id}.

tools.name: zeevou_list_bookings
tools.description: List bookings, filterable by property, unit type, status, channel, guest email and arrival or departure date range. Zeevou API: GET /apis/bookings.

tools.name: zeevou_get_booking
tools.description: Get one booking by id, with arrival and departure dates, status, guest, property, unit type, channel and payment status. Zeevou API: GET /apis/bookings/{id}.

tools.name: zeevou_list_guests
tools.description: List guest profiles, filterable by name, email or mobile number. Zeevou API: GET /apis/guests.

tools.name: zeevou_get_guest
tools.description: Get one guest profile by id, with contact details and guest level. Zeevou API: GET /apis/guests/{id}.

tools.name: zeevou_list_rate_plans
tools.description: List rate plans (the price rules attached to unit types). Use zeevou_list_unit_types to find a unit type id. Zeevou API: GET /apis/rate_plans.

tools.name: zeevou_list_tasks
tools.description: List operational tasks (housekeeping, maintenance and similar), filterable by status, type, priority, property, booking and due date. Zeevou API: GET /apis/tasks.

tools.name: zeevou_get_task
tools.description: Get one task by id, with its subject, status, priority, deadline and linked booking. Zeevou API: GET /apis/tasks/{id}.

tools.name: zeevou_list_reviews
tools.description: List guest reviews, filterable by property, unit type, booking channel and review date range. Zeevou API: GET /apis/reviews.

tools.name: zeevou_list_channels
tools.description: List the booking channels (for example, OTAs) connected to the account, and whether each is active. Zeevou API: GET /apis/channels.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: zeevou_list_bookings, zeevou_list_guests, zeevou_list_reviews · Private data: zeevou_get_guest · Public sink: zeevou_list_bookings, zeevou_list_guests.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: zeevou_list_bookings, zeevou_list_guests, zeevou_list_reviews · Private data: zeevou_get_guest · Public sink: zeevou_list_bookings, zeevou_list_guests

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
